articles.title: Bitcoin bucks tech selloff as AI safety concerns weigh on stocks
articles.snippet: Bitcoin rose above $77,000 as calls to slow AI development hit technology shares, while rising oil prices added to market pressure.

articles.title: Anthropic chief urges slowdown in AI development to safer pace
articles.snippet: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman agrees with safety concerns regarding AI development, says no initial share sale this year.

articles.title: Trump Says He’s the Only ‘Guardrails’ AI Needs, Attacks Anthropic and Defends Data Centers
articles.snippet: The president dismissed calls for tighter AI controls as industry leaders push to slow development and address safety failures.
